mapper.sql: CASE WHEN TO_DATE(request_start_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') > TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN '모집예정' WHEN TO_DATE(request_end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN '모집마감' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_REQUEST C WHERE (C.request_type = '온라인') AND C.lecture_id = LECTURE_INFO.lecture_id AND C.request_status NOT IN('예약취소')) >= (online_person_count + wait_person_count) THEN '정원마감' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_REQUEST C WHERE C.request_status = '추첨대기' AND C.lecture_id = LECTURE_INFO.lecture_id) >= (wait_person_count) AND request_type = '추첨제' THEN '정원마감' WHEN TO_DATE(request_start_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(request_end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN '모집중' END AS lecture_status1, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(edu_start_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') > TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN '교육대기' WHEN TO_DATE(edu_start_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(edu_end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') >= TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN '교육중' WHEN TO_DATE(edu_end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') < TO_DATE(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') THEN '교육마감' END AS lecture_status2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_REQUEST C WHERE C.request_type = '온라인' AND C.request_status = '예약완료' AND C.lecture_id = LECTURE_INFO.lecture_id) AS online_request_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_REQUEST C WHERE C.request_type = '오프라인' AND C.request_status = '예약완료' AND C.lecture_id = LECTURE_INFO.lecture_id) AS offline_request_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_REQUEST C WHERE C.request_status IN ('예약대기', '추첨대기') AND C.lecture_id = LECTURE_INFO.lecture_id) AS wait_request_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lecture_id) AS reverse_rownum, homepage_id, course_id,lecture_id,lecture_title,
